candidates.name: Get-Location
verified_facts: Get-Location returns information about the current working location
PowerShell can maintain location stacks independently for providers
semantic_limits: A current location value does not prove it matches the canonical task working directory or that required files exist

candidates.name: Resolve-Path
verified_facts: Resolve-Path resolves matching existing items and returns PathInfo by default
LiteralPath avoids wildcard interpretation
semantic_limits: Resolve-Path only resolves existing paths and does not prove file identity, permissions or freshness

candidates.name: Join-Path
verified_facts: Join-Path combines parent and child path segments using provider-specific delimiters
Additional child segments can be joined explicitly
semantic_limits: A syntactically composed path may not exist and may still point outside the intended canonical root

candidates.name: Test-Path
verified_facts: Test-Path determines whether path elements exist
PathType can distinguish container and leaf expectations
semantic_limits: Existence and type checks do not establish content integrity, ownership, write access or canonical origin

candidates.name: Convert-Path
verified_facts: Convert-Path converts a PowerShell path to a provider-native path
Converted output can be captured before native tool invocation
semantic_limits: Conversion does not prove the path is inside the approved worktree or safe for mutation

candidates.name: Split-Path
verified_facts: Split-Path returns selected portions of a path such as parent, leaf or qualifier
LiteralPath supports exact path text
semantic_limits: Decomposed components must be recombined and compared to the resolved canonical path; component checks alone are insufficient

candidates.name: about_Environment_Variables
verified_facts: PowerShell exposes environment variables through the Environment provider and Env drive
Environment variables are inherited by child processes according to process creation context
semantic_limits: Environment values are mutable session context and do not prove the child process actually used the expected executable or repository

candidates.name: about_PSModulePath
verified_facts: PSModulePath contains locations PowerShell searches for modules and resources
Search-path ordering can affect which module version is discovered
semantic_limits: A module path entry does not prove a module is trusted, imported, compatible or the exact intended version

candidates.name: Get-Culture
verified_facts: Get-Culture returns current culture settings including number and date display formats
Culture information can be recorded to interpret locale-sensitive text
semantic_limits: Culture readback does not make locale-sensitive parsing safe; machine-readable receipts must use explicit invariant formats

candidates.name: Get-UICulture
verified_facts: Get-UICulture returns current user-interface culture settings
UI culture affects localized text such as menus and messages
semantic_limits: Localized message text must not be the primary success or failure discriminator; structured codes and fields remain required

candidates.name: Get-ComputerInfo
verified_facts: Get-ComputerInfo returns consolidated system and operating-system properties
The cmdlet is available on Windows and can expose version and architecture context
semantic_limits: Host metadata does not prove runner ownership, current health, receipt production or Git publication

candidates.name: Get-Module
verified_facts: Get-Module lists modules imported in the current session or available through ListAvailable
Module objects expose names, versions and exported commands
semantic_limits: An available module is not necessarily imported, trusted, compatible or the source of the command that actually ran

candidates.name: Import-Module
verified_facts: Import-Module adds module members to the current session
An explicit path or module information object can constrain the imported module
semantic_limits: Import success does not validate module behavior or authenticity; exact path, version and command source must be recorded

candidates.name: about_Modules
verified_facts: PowerShell modules package reusable commands and can be discovered from PSModulePath
PowerShell can automatically import modules when a command is first used
semantic_limits: Automatic loading can hide version or path ambiguity and must not substitute for explicit module provenance in recovery receipts

candidates.name: Measure-Command
verified_facts: Measure-Command measures how long a script block or command takes to run
The result is a TimeSpan object
semantic_limits: Elapsed duration alone does not distinguish success, failure, blocking I/O or child-process continuation

candidates.name: Start-Sleep
verified_facts: Start-Sleep suspends activity in a script or session for a specified interval
The delay can be expressed with bounded seconds or milliseconds
semantic_limits: Sleeping is not progress and must not be used to conceal indefinite pending; retry count and total deadline must remain finite

candidates.name: Copy-Item
verified_facts: Copy-Item copies an item from one location to another
Literal paths and PassThru can support exact snapshot and readback workflows
semantic_limits: A completed copy does not prove byte identity or durability; destination hash, length and content must be validated

candidates.name: Rename-Item
verified_facts: Rename-Item changes the name of an item without changing its location
LiteralPath can identify the source exactly
semantic_limits: The documentation does not establish crash-safe atomic receipt replacement; rename results require final-path readback

candidates.name: Compress-Archive
verified_facts: Compress-Archive creates ZIP archives from specified files and directories
The cmdlet uses ZipArchive and documents a 2 GB per-file limitation
semantic_limits: Compress-Archive ignores hidden files and folders, so it cannot be assumed to capture a complete dirty-repository snapshot

candidates.name: Expand-Archive
verified_facts: Expand-Archive extracts files from a ZIP archive to a destination directory
LiteralPath and PassThru can support isolated archive validation
semantic_limits: Successful extraction does not prove completeness or identity; expanded file inventory, hashes and encoding-sensitive names must be checked
